content:
Have you attempted IELTS test? If yes, I am sure that you might have become anxious about the results of IELTS exam. For IELTS results, 13 days is a constant wait and then finally the result day comes, which will decide the future!

But sometimes, you may get an e-mail notifying that IELTS results are ‘withheld or delayed’.

At the time you may be presented with many emotions like anxiety, nervousness, fear, fright, annoyance and much more. You may be in a state that what had exactly happed? Or you may think what to do?

Here you can do two things. Either you can contact the test Centre or you can wait until you get the result. Casper Academy of Excellence is the leading IELTS training centre in Ernakulam to support and guide to attain your dreams.

Reasons for Such a Statement

IELTS test results can be delayed or withheld due to three different reasons. You must go through these reasons at least once. We can see one by one as follows:

First Term and Condition

Your IELTS test result may take than 13 days to come if IELTS test partners want to review your test thoroughly. There can be two reasons for this to happen:

  • The IELTS test partners would like to recheck your test – They will conduct a re-check on your test if they find a difference of two or more bands in each module. If you have scored well in listening, they will expect you to assume that the score will be similar for writing. Sometimes, the test partners may also ask you to re-appear for a component or two.
  • They may want to conduct a quality control check on how the test is managed. Casper Academy of Excellence is the best IELTS coaching centre in Ernakulam to deliver excellent IELTS coaching with expert trainers.

Second Term and Condition

Sometimes, your result may get cancelled after its issuance when they find any irregularity in the IELTS test. You may be in a need to re-take one or more IELTS components. With the word irregularity, it refers to some unusual or unacceptable action which may directly affect your test in any manner. The test administrators will undertake strict quality control procedures at all times. This is done to maintain the integrity of the IELTS test. With this your result may come under scrutiny and your result may become withheld or delayed.

Third Term and Condition

Your test result may get cancelled, if any of the data on the Test Report Form provided by you to your recognizing organizations got altered in any way. You must make sure that you are providing accurate information. The Casper Academy of Excellence is the best IELTS trainers in Kochi providing full assistance to get through the test.
